experience.description:
● Assembled and wired 3D printers in the production workshop; supported mechanical integration of hardware units.
● Independently developed a custom tool to automate part of the 3d printer production process → Reduced manual workload and improved production efficiency.
● Recognized for initiative and technical contribution → transitioned to full-time software developer after internship.

● Led development of 3+ full-stack platforms for hardware control, e-commerce and admin tools.
● Designed MVC-based backend services; took ownership of DevOps responsibilities including CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment → Reduced release friction and increased delivery speed.
● Refactored legacy code into modular structures → enhanced maintainability and scalability.

● Delivered 3+ client-facing dashboards with reusable UI components and clean architecture.
● Wrote reusable front-end components following clean architecture principles → Reduced future maintenance overhead by 50%.

● Analyzed and digitized production workflows → reduced manual errors, improved visibility.
● Built inventory and melting efficiency tracking systems → achieved 60% reporting accuracy gain.
● Deployed automation in non-digital environments → improved productivity with minimal cost
